headline: Khaitan & Co, NovoJuris Legal act on Giva $100 million Series D fundraise
sum: Indiejewel Fashions Private Limited, dba Giva, has raised $100 million from a Series D fundraise led by Multiples, through a combination of primary and secondary. Existing investors Edelweiss, and Epiq also participated in the round.
detail: Indiejewel Fashions Private Limited, dba Giva, has raised $100 million from a Series D fundraise led by Multiples, through a combination of primary and secondary. Existing investors Edelweiss, and Epiq also participated in the round. Khaitan & Co advised Giva on this fundraise. The Firm assisted Giva in drafting, review, negotiation, finalisation and execution of the transaction documents, and closing of the transaction.
